question: Who secured gold in the Women’s Singles SU5 at the 2025 Asia Para Badminton Championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manisha Ramadass**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manisha Ramadass** secured the **gold medal** in the **Women’s Singles SU5** category at the **2025 Asia Para Badminton Championship**.
 
• In the final match, she defeated her fellow Indian teammate **Thulasimathi Murugesan** to claim the title, highlighting India's dominance in this specific classification.
 
• The **2025 Asia Para Badminton Championship** is a premier continental event sanctioned by the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**, attracting the best para-shuttlers from across **Asia**.
 
• This victory further cements her status as a world-class athlete in the **SU5 classification**, which is for players with **upper limb impairments**.
 
• Her performance in the tournament is a continuation of her exceptional form, contributing significantly to the **Indian para-badminton team's** overall medal tally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **SU5 Classification**:
 
 
• The **SU5** category in **para-badminton** is for athletes who have impairments in their **upper limbs**.
 
• The impairment could be on the **playing or non-playing hand**, which affects the player's **balance**, **movement**, and **power** during the game.
 
 
 
• **Manisha Ramadass**:
 
 
• She hails from **Tamil Nadu** and has been a rising star in Indian para-sports.
 
• She was honored as the **BWF Female Para-Badminton Player of the Year** in **2022**.
 
• She won the **bronze medal** at the **Paris 2024 Paralympic Games**, making her one of the most successful athletes in her category.
 
 
 
• **Thulasimathi Murugesan**:
 
 
• She is another top-tier Indian para-shuttler who secured the **silver medal** at the **2025 Asia Championships** after losing to Manisha in the final.
 
• She notably won the **silver medal** at the **Paris 2024 Paralympics**, showcasing the high level of competition within the Indian contingent.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Indian Para-Badminton Success**:
 
 
• India has become a global powerhouse in **para-badminton**, consistently winning medals at the **Paralympic Games**, **World Championships**, and **Asian Para Games**.
 
• Players like **Mandeep Kaur** (SL3 category) and **Palak Kohli** (SL4/SU5 category) are other prominent names who have represented India at the highest levels of the sport.
 
 
 
• **Tournament Significance**:
 
 
• Continental championships like the **Asia Para Badminton Championship** are crucial for athletes to gain **BWF world ranking points**.
 
• High rankings are essential for qualification into major global events like the **World Para Badminton Championships** and the **Los Angeles 2028 Paralympic Games**.
 
• The support provided by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** through the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** has been instrumental in the success of these para-athletes.
